name: Save contact import mapping
description: Call this when a contact import file has already been uploaded and analyzed and you need to commit the column-to-attribute mapping, the target lists, and the import options so the import job can run. Use contacts.suggest_mapping_from_file first to obtain a proposed column mapping, and contacts.analyze_import_file to obtain the process id and line count this call refers to; afterwards use contacts.get_import_notification to follow the resulting import. For adding or removing contacts on a list without a file, use contacts.bulk_modify_list instead.
preconditions: An import file must already have been uploaded and analyzed, producing the process_id referenced here.
Each target list in `lists` must already exist.
The contact attributes named in `mapdata` must already exist (see contacts.create_attribute).

mapdata.description: Ordered column mapping for the uploaded file: one contact attribute name per file column, in file column order (e.g. ["EMAIL","FIRSTNAME","LASTNAME"]).

lists.description: Target lists for the imported contacts, keyed by list id with the list id as value (e.g. {"5":5}).

totalLines.description: Number of data lines detected in the uploaded import file.

listDetails.description: Human-readable label for the selected lists as shown in the UI, e.g. "[5] catalog-test-list".

process_id.description: Identifier of the import process created when the file was uploaded and analyzed.

countryCode.description: Default country code used to interpret phone numbers in the file; empty string when none is selected.

type.description: Channel the import is keyed on.

updateExistingContacts.description: Whether contacts already present in the account are updated with values from the file.

allowReplaceWithEmpty.description: Whether empty values in the file overwrite existing attribute values.

emailBlacklist.description: Whether imported contacts are blacklisted for email.

smsBlacklist.description: Whether imported contacts are blacklisted for SMS.

whatsappBlacklist.description: Whether imported contacts are blacklisted for WhatsApp.

result.description: Status of the save, observed as "OK" on success.

side_effects: The import mapping and options are stored against the import process, committing how the uploaded file's columns are interpreted.
Contacts from the file are added to the selected lists.
Existing contacts may be overwritten when updateExistingContacts is true, and existing attribute values may be cleared when allowReplaceWithEmpty is true.
Imported contacts may be blacklisted for email, SMS, or WhatsApp depending on the blacklist flags.
ui_path: Map your file columns to Brevo contact attributes
